title: Okada’s Unified Championship reign
summary: Okada renews his rivalry with Omega in AEW, wins two championships, and later faces Moxley in the Continental Classic.

chapters.title: Okada wins the unification match
chapters.result: Okada defeats Omega to become AEW Unified Champion.
chapters.context: The match combines the International and Continental championships.

chapters.title: Moxley takes the Continental crown
chapters.result: Moxley defeats Okada in the Continental Classic final.
chapters.context: Okada’s run with both championships ends as the titles separate.
